That checkout has moved off the pin and its historical configuration is not recorded anywhere in this repository, so it is not reproducible. Every consequence of that substitution is itemised in the report.

No gate was bypassed and no command was rewritten: the pinned route received byte-identical database content to the --compile-database the current route received.
The prepared Monkey source copy lives under this worktree, so the four wrapper paths that embed an absolute source path differ from the archived ones. This is location provenance, not analysis.
